questions.question: नारायणमुिनः िकमथ उवशीं सृज्यते ? Narayana created Urvasi for ?
questions.solution_html: • The sages Nara-Narayana were performing intense tapas (penance) at Badarik āś rama. Indra, fearing that their austerity might threaten his position, sent celestial nymphs (apsar ā s) to disturb them.To demonstrate their spiritual power and detachment, N ā r ā ya ṇ a Muni created an extraordinarily beautiful woman from his own thigh (uru).This maiden surpassed all the apsar ā s in beauty; hence she was named Urvashi (born from the thigh).The humbled apsar ā s returned, and Urva śī was then sent to Indra’s court.
questions.final_answer: The sages Nara-Narayana were performing intense tapas (penance) at Badarik āś rama. Indra, fearing that their austerity might threaten his position, sent celestial nymphs (apsar ā s) to disturb them.To demonstrate their spiritual power and detachment, N ā r ā ya ṇ a Muni created an extraordinarily beautiful woman from his own thigh (uru).This maiden surpassed all the apsar ā s in beauty; hence she was named Urvashi (born from the thigh).The humbled apsar ā s returned, and Urva śī was then sent to Indra’s court.
